sasha-eng: FYI — noticed a dedicated pool spiking and staying ~3x the reserved throughput for ~8m this morning, other tenants started getting evicted. Is there a smoothing / eviction change rolled out?
ben-platform: Not that I'm aware of. Which pool + tenant?
sasha-eng: pool-prod-gpu-5, tenant 'acme-analytics'. Cloud logs show sustained high QPS vs their reserved_qps. eviction events around 06:12-06:22.
marta-ml: I saw the same on our telemetry. The smoothing metric shows a tiny window (30s) so short bursts are treated as sustained pretty quickly.
jing-sre: Can you paste the eviction log snippet? I want to confirm it was quota preemption not OOM.
sasha-eng: Sure, log tail: ```
[2026-02-12T06:12:05Z] eviction: tenant=acme-analytics pool=prod-gpu-5 used_pct=214 reserved_pct=70 reason=quota_exceeded smoothing_window_s=30
[2026-02-12T06:14:02Z] eviction: tenant=small-team pool=prod-gpu-5 used_pct=92 reserved_pct=50 reason=preempted_for_reservation
```
ben-platform: Ok so current defaults: smoothing_window_s=30, burst_credit_capacity=1.5x reserved for short bursts, eviction_threshold=150% of reserved. That config was meant to prevent short ripples, but 30s is maybe too aggressive for workloads with heavy startup sequences.
marta-ml: Their workload ramps up for ~5m when model warming + long generation jobs start. A 30s smoothing window will consider that sustained. We should consider a sliding percentile (p95 over 5m) rather than simple avg.
jing-sre: Also seeing we have no per-tenant credit visibility in Console — operators only see pool-wide utilization. That made diagnosing slower. We should add a "per-tenant credit balance" chart + an "eviction events" trace.
ben-platform: Agreed. Proposed short-term changes: increase smoothing_window_s to 300 for dedicated pools with long-run jobs; add a grace TTL so preempted requests get a 60s soft-fail before hard eviction; and emit eviction_reason tags for easier filtering.
sasha-eng: Sounds reasonable. Any runtime concerns? Will increasing smoothing make us tolerate real noisy tenants too long and hurt latency SLOs for others?
ben-platform: Tradeoff. We can combine with an adaptive preemption: if pool utilization > 95% and a tenant is above 2x reserved for > 5m, mark it for hard eviction sooner. So smoothing longer but with a top-level hard threshold.
marta-ml: We should also prevent one tenant from hoarding burst credits indefinitely. Current burst_credit_capacity resets slowly. Suggest hard cap per-tenant: max_burst_tokens = min(3x reserved, 10k tokens) and decay rate that is exponential so long-running usage drains credits faster.
jing-sre: From alerting side: add two alerts — pool_utilization > 90% for 2m, and per-tenant_used_pct > 200% for 3m. Also a diagnostic runbook: how to check `rbacctl tenant credits <tenant>` and `kubectl logs -n infra quota-controller`.
ben-platform: I'll open a config PR w/ default smoothing_window_s=300 and adaptive_hard_threshold=true. I'll also add metric names: `dedicated.pool.{pool}.utilization`, `dedicated.tenant.{tenant}.burst_balance`, `dedicated.evictions.count`.
sasha-eng: Can we also expose a small per-tenant view in Console: current_reserved, current_used, burst_balance, last_eviction_ts? Very helpful for support.
infra-bot: NOTE: deploy queued: config-change/smoothing-default -> staging at 14:00 UTC (CI check pending).
marta-ml: We need an A/B rollout: small percentage of pools first, then gradual ramp. Also an integration test that simulates 10m rampups.
ben-platform: Agreed — will add canary flags and a job in eng-releases to run the long-ramp test.
jing-sre: Assigning tasks: ben -> PR + metrics emit; marta -> test harness scenario; sasha -> Console mockups for per-tenant chart; jing -> alert playbook + runbook. I'll create the Jira tickets.
sasha-eng: Thanks. Also add a retrospective query: which tenants have >3 evictions in last 30d so product can reach out.
ben-platform: Will add an internal telemetry query: `SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM evictions WHERE ts > now()-30d GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 50`.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-change/smoothing-default -> staging (job 8743)
sasha-eng: OK let's reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
